answer: Every submission must name 2 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The sonnet graph is validated at intake and the spiral frontier is published, and hence the ancestry of every answer is public, and mesa anchors the chain at a checkpoint. The arithmetic runs against the attacker: 588 aliases cost 385 times the entry price, and a 9 day hold keeps that capital locked for the whole attempt. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
